name: Etched Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Etched Sigil calls new night elf hunters to Ayanna Everstride.

sections.title: Summons of the Wilds
sections.body: Newly awakened night elf hunters receive the Etched Sigil when they enter Shadowglen. Its carved marks carry a welcome from Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer who lives high in Aldrassil’s hollowed boughs. The sigil sends each novice to seek her out and begin learning archery and wilderness tracking, along with the night elf bond between stalker and beast.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Sigil?
aliases: why do i have this sigil
faq.answer: The Etched Sigil summons a novice night elf hunter to seek Ayanna Everstride in Aldrassil. There, training begins in survival, tracking, and archery.

aliases: where did etched sigil come from
faq.answer: Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer in Shadowglen, sends the Etched Sigil.

faq.q: Where should the sigil be taken?
aliases: where do i bring etched sigil
who do i give etched sigil to
faq.answer: Bring the sigil to Ayanna Everstride atop Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why do night elf hunters receive a sigil rather than a paper letter?
aliases: why a sigil instead of letter
what is the sigil made of
faq.answer: Ayanna's welcome comes as a carved sigil marked with signs of the hunt. It speaks for her and calls each new hunter to find her in Aldrassil.

angles.text: As a hunter, the Etched Sigil marks the beginning of your training with the bow and the ways of beasts under Ayanna Everstride.
As a night elf, you receive the sigil in Shadowglen, among the canopy traditions of night elf foresters who safeguard Teldrassil.
